selection: CWE weakness variants ranked by CWE-declared language, language-class, and technology applicability; explicit incompatible language declarations are excluded
promotion_boundary: No candidate is executable until it has ecosystem-specific semantics, positive, negative, and adversarial fixtures, false-positive analysis, and measured precision

root_overlap.policy: A CWE root may repeat across ecosystems, but an (ecosystem, CWE) pair may not. Every repeat carries root_overlap_group and existing-rule references.
